Skip to contentHENRY ETZKOWITZPALO ALTO · 2026
HENRY ETZKOWITZ FOR PALO ALTO · 2026
# A city of ideas.
A future for everyone.
Fresh thinking. Deep experience. A shared commitment to a Palo Alto where innovation serves the people who call it home.
Explore the vision
GET TO KNOW HENRY
ROOTED IN PALO ALTO.LOOKING TO THE FUTURE.
A hopeful city.
A brighter future.
Open water. Open ideas.A city for every generation.Vote for Henry.Big, bold ideas.
01 MEET HENRY
## A scholar of innovation.
A champion of possibility.
Explore Henry’s academic background
Henry Etzkowitz has dedicated his career to understanding how new ideas become meaningful change.
A renowned scholar in innovation studies, Henry is known for the Triple Helix model: the collaboration between universities, industry, and government that helps communities turn knowledge into opportunity.
His 2026 campaign brings that collaborative perspective to Palo Alto—with a focus on connecting big ideas to the everyday needs of our city.
INNOVATION STUDIESTHE TRIPLE HELIXCOLLABORATIVE LEADERSHIP
02 THE VISION
## Innovation should improve
life. Not just technology.
Palo Alto is a place where the world’s next ideas take shape. Let’s bring that same imagination to housing, our neighborhoods, and the way we govern.
### Better together.
Connect our community, local businesses, and research institutions to solve shared challenges—with residents at the heart of every conversation.
THE TRIPLE HELIX. A LOCAL PURPOSE.
03 THE PRIORITIES
## Big-picture thinking.
Everyday progress.
A proposed program for a stronger Palo Alto, built around the issues that shape our shared future.
01
HOUSING & BELONGING
### A place for every generation
Explore thoughtful housing options so teachers, young professionals, families, and older residents can build a life in Palo Alto—while protecting the character of our neighborhoods.
02
INNOVATION & LOCAL ECONOMY
### Ideas that create opportunity
Strengthen connections between research, small businesses, and civic life. Help local entrepreneurs thrive and make the benefits of innovation more widely accessible.
03
CLIMATE & MOBILITY
### A resilient, livable city
Prioritize a greener city with safer walking and cycling, practical transportation choices, and climate-conscious planning that improves everyday life.
04
OPEN & COLLABORATIVE GOVERNMENT
### A city hall that listens
Bring residents into decisions earlier. Support clear communication, accessible public discussions, and evidence-informed policies with meaningful accountability.
04 MAKE IT OUR FUTURE
## Palo Alto’s next chapter
starts with us.
Support Henry Etzkowitz in the 2026 Palo Alto elections.
